name: get_place
description: One verified place by id, slug or name (fuzzy name matching, aliases and former names included), with hours, open_now, source_url, verified_date, call_to_confirm and the owner claim link. Returns found=false rather than guessing.

name: open_now
description: Places open at a given moment (default now, America/New_York) in a town or category, judged only from posted hours. Verified hours are listed first. Places with unknown hours are returned separately with call_to_confirm=true and are never counted as open.

name: events
description: Reviewed upcoming events (America/New_York times), each with the organizer's official page as source_url. Filter by town, date range and words.

name: conditions
description: Current USGS lake-level and water readings for Finger Lakes gauges that are reporting (provisional), with official links for lakes that are not.

name: ask
description: Plain-language question about the region (what is open tonight, events this weekend, where to eat, local services, moving here). The answer is built only from verified records and guide pages, with every source linked, and says so when the data does not cover it. 15 questions a minute and 300 a day

name: news
description: Recent items from the network's town news desks; each summarizes a named public source with its link and date.

name: get_town
description: One town: guide link, official site, coordinates, its verified places, and upcoming reviewed events.

name: get_beverage_places
description: Search manufacturer listings compiled from the New York State Liquor Authority public active-license dataset (data.ny.gov 9s3h-dpkz) for counties from Broome west through Erie and Niagara, including the Finger Lakes and Southern Tier.
